title: Return a redirect
summary: Gin: Return a redirect. Inspect the initial 302 response.
introduction: Redirect asks the client to visit a new URL. GET /start ends at /hello in a browser.

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Return a redirect

blocks.text: Redirect sends status 302 and the target URL. The next GET reads the greeting.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A redirect is a second client request.
